content.comment_body: Hello, I need advice on how to map inputs and outputs between one [product_name] module and another. Previously, I successfully mapped between [product_name] and [version_no] using a sample I found online. However, now I'm having trouble with direct mapping between two [product_name] modules. I’ve attached the connection settings (TSAP) and mapping details I used for [product_name] and [version_no]. Now, I am uncertain about the correct settings for both [product_name] modules and the required mapping addresses. Before, when mapping between [product_name] and [version_no], I simply used the data block address for the remote address and set TSAP to 10.01. I’d appreciate any guidance.
You don’t need an intermediary like [version_no] for connecting one [product_name] module to another. Direct communication between [product_name] modules is possible.

Hello, do you have a sample project demonstrating this? If so, could you share the link or provide an example? I’m having trouble mapping between two [product_name] modules. I know how to control outputs by activating inputs from another module, but mapping addresses is proving difficult. Previously, I just connected lines directly in network mode when programming. Now, since I need the specific addresses, I’m trying to set it up manually without network mode.

Once, I created a simple project for this purpose. You can set up a connection between the modules by creating a line and then double-clicking the connection line to open the connection table. When using VB addresses, make sure the values aren’t identical for both modules.
Thank you for sharing your experience. I’m currently working based on your advice.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering difficulties directly mapping inputs and outputs between two [product_name] modules, especially since previous experience involved mapping between [product_name] and [version_no] using network mode and easy address configurations. There is confusion around required settings and address setup for direct module-to-module communication without network mode. The community has confirmed direct mapping is possible and offered guidance on addressing, though no clear example or reference has been provided in this thread.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a straightforward method and step-by-step instructions to map I/O between two [product_name] modules. They would benefit from sample projects, links, or configuration guides that clarify the process.
